description: This file contains internal bit manipulation functions for the Abseil C++ library, including bit rotation, population count, leading and trailing zero counts, and related utilities, with platform-specific optimizations.

methods.name: IsPowerOf2
methods.description: Checks if an unsigned integer is a power of two.

methods.name: RotateRight
methods.description: Performs a bitwise right rotation on an unsigned value.

methods.name: RotateLeft
methods.description: Performs a bitwise left rotation on an unsigned value.

methods.name: Popcount32
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: Popcount64
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: Popcount
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in an unsigned integer of any size.

methods.name: CountLeadingZeroes32
methods.description: Counts leading zeros in a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: CountLeadingZeroes16
methods.description: Counts leading zeros in a 16-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: CountLeadingZeroes64
methods.description: Counts leading zeros in a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: CountLeadingZeroes
methods.description: Counts leading zeros in an unsigned integer of any size.

methods.name: CountTrailingZeroesNonzero32
methods.description: Counts trailing zeros in a non-zero 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: CountTrailingZeroesNonzero64
methods.description: Counts trailing zeros in a non-zero 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: CountTrailingZeroesNonzero16
methods.description: Counts trailing zeros in a non-zero 16-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: CountTrailingZeroes
methods.description: Counts trailing zeros in an unsigned integer of any size.

methods.name: BitCeilPromotionHelper
methods.description: Helper for bit ceiling calculations, ensuring wraparound behavior.

methods.name: BitCeilNonPowerOf2
methods.description: Calculates the bit ceiling of a non-power-of-two unsigned integer.
